tools.name: estimate_rate
tools.description: Estimate what an Indian Instagram or YouTube creator charges per deliverable, in INR, from their follower count and (optionally) average likes, comments, views and niche. Returns a price per product (Reel, Story, post, package; or YouTube integration, dedicated video, Short) when engagement figures

tools.name: check_creator
tools.description: Check a social media creator's audience for authenticity signals before working with them: follower quality, engagement patterns, comment authenticity, growth and posting cadence. Returns an authenticity score (0-100) with the signals behind it and a link to the full public report. Works for Instagr

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_creator · Public sink: estimate_rate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_creator · Public sink: estimate_rate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
